title: Real Affix or Not?
rule: Some words only look like they have a prefix or suffix. Take the ending or beginning off. If a real word is left, it is a prefix or suffix. If not, it is just part of the word.
trickText: Cover the ending or beginning. Read what is left. Is it a real word? Jumped: take off ed, jump is a word, so ed is a suffix. Red: take off ed, r is not a word, so ed is just part of red.
say: Today's case: real or fake. Some words only look like they have an ending or a beginning added. Take it off and look at what is left. If it is a real word, you found a suffix or prefix. If it is not, it is just part of the word.

discover.intro: Sort these words. Is ed a suffix, or just part of the word?

groups.label: ed is a suffix
groups.why: Take ed off and a real word is left.

groups.label: ed is part of the word
groups.why: Take ed off and no real word is left.

discover.question: How can you tell if ed is a suffix?

options.label: Take it off. If a real word is left, it is a suffix
If the word ends in ed, it is always a suffix
If the word is short, it is a suffix

discover.reveal: Yes! Take the ending off. If a real word is left, like jump in jumped, it is a suffix. In red, r is not a word, so ed is just part of the word.
